info.title: Decision Flow API
info.description: Run and manage decision flows over HTTP. Create an API key in Settings, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Each key holds some of the `read`, `write` and `run` scopes; an operation your key lacks returns 403.

delete.description:
Hard mode removes the flow and its runs for good; soft mode only hides the flow.

Requires the `write` scope.

get.description:
Newest first; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

Requires the `read` scope.

Step history from the trace store; `pending` while the trace is still being written.

Requires the `read` scope.

put.description:
Saves even an invalid graph (autosave); problems are reported by `validate_flow`.

Requires the `write` scope.

post.description:
Validates the draft, then freezes it as the next numbered version.

Requires the `write` scope.

Runs inline. A failure or timeout is a 200 "failed"; bad input is 422; too many runs, 429.

Requires the `run` scope.

Runs the published version of a flow. Send only `input`; drafts cannot be triggered. Same result as creating a run.

Requires the `run` scope.

HTTPBearer.description: An API key created in Settings.
